skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Ronin Huntress
skins.content: 0011 Tempest-Series New Arrival/Patrolling Ronin. Several designers joined forces to create a look inspired by the style of the streets. Complete with the redesigned shield of an L.G.D. Officer joined with traditional elements from Higashi, this outfit brings a truly formidable look.
skins.quote: The nightmare that haunts all gangs alike in Lungmen, large or small.

skins.name: Seeker SK97
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Seeker Series Swimming Suit SK97. The material is light, breathable and exquisite. It's been tailored to meet the needs of those go-getter explorers.
skins.quote: If they knew that Hoshiguma crushed the coconut she'd finished drinking with her bare hands before throwing it in the trash, would the waves washing onto the artificial beach become quieter?
